Generates a patchy volumetric density field from procedural noise by applying a power function and a threshold to create sparse structures [S1, unofficial].

The provided notes for Source [S1] explicitly describe the process of generating a patchy volumetric density field from noise. It details mapping noise to [0, 1], applying a power function (exponent 2.5) to create sparse regions, and applying a threshold (0.15) to set low densities to zero. This aligns perfectly with the claim's description of using a power function and threshold to create sparse structures from procedural noise.
